facts_raw.Focus: AI infrastructure, AI apps, healthcare, cyber, consumer, robotics/hardware
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: AI startup，需能利用 Anthropic/Claude 生态产生差异化价值；Pre-seed–Series A 均可能。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: AI infra / apps / cyber / healthcare / consumer / robotics & hardware；强技术 team、真实 usage、可形成大市场。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 不是传统 accelerator，无统一 on-site 要求；Menlo 提供 SF / Menlo Park fractional workspace 与 founder events。
facts_raw.International Founder: International companies considered; US preferred per current positioning
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 非 residency，不提供统一 relocation/visa 项目。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 官网在线申请；也可联系 Anthology Fund investment team。
facts_raw.Public Contact Name: Deedy Das; Amy Wu Martin; Venky Ganesan; Tim Tully; Matt Murphy; Joff Redfern
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: Menlo 官网明确可通过各 Partner bio 上公开邮箱联系，或直接在线 Apply。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 硬件 / 机器人 / DeepTech；MedTech / Health / Bio；AI / AI-native；阶段以 Pre-seed–Series A 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目；只有想法、无 MVP/traction 的极早期项目
facts_raw.Notes: Top-tier AI founder route: Anthropic access, credits, quarterly deep dives, founder community and biannual demo days.

facts.Focus: AI infrastructure, AI apps, healthcare, cyber, consumer, robotics/hardware
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: AI startups with differentiated value from the Anthropic/Claude ecosystem; pre-seed through Series A may qualify.
facts.Strong-to-Have: AI infrastructure and applications, cybersecurity, healthcare, consumer, robotics and hardware. Strong technical teams, real usage and large market potential.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Not a traditional accelerator and no standard attendance requirement. Menlo offers fractional workspace in SF and Menlo Park, plus founder events.
facts.International Founder: International companies considered; US preferred per current positioning
facts.Visa / Relocation: Not a residency; no standard relocation or visa program.
facts.Application Materials: Online application or contact with the Anthology Fund investment team.
facts.Public Contact Name: Deedy Das; Amy Wu Martin; Venky Ganesan; Tim Tully; Matt Murphy; Joff Redfern
facts.Public Contact Route: Apply online or contact a Menlo partner through the public email address on their official biography.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Hardware / Robotics / DeepTech; MedTech / Health / Bio; AI / AI-native; primarily at the Pre-seed–Series A stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration; Projects without core technology or IP, including undifferentiated apps and trading businesses; Idea-only projects without an MVP or traction
facts.Notes: Top-tier AI founder route: Anthropic access, credits, quarterly deep dives, founder community and biannual demo days.
